# BB Breakout (4h) — six-year deep dive on SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA, GALA

*Generated by `bb-deep.js` on 2026-10-21. Binance USDT-M futures 4h candles. Data starts (listing dates): SOL 2020-09, ZEC 2020-02, NEAR 2020-10, ADA 2020-01, GALA 2021-09; all to 20 Oct 2026.*

## How this was tested

**Rules (frozen):** at the close of a 4h candle, go long if it closed above the upper Bollinger band (20, 2σ) and above the 200-candle SMA; go short if it closed below the lower band and below the SMA. The stop is the middle band at that close. The target is 4× the stop distance. If neither is hit, exit at the next open after 48 candles (8 days). One trade at a time per coin; no new signal while in a trade.

**Execution:** an independent bot gets one *closed* candle at a time and recomputes every indicator only from candles it has already seen. It decides at the close and fills at the next candle's open. A candle that touches both the stop and the target counts as a stop.

**Costs (Binance base tier):** 0.05% taker fee + 0.02% slippage on the entry, stop and time exit; 0.02% maker fee on the take-profit, which only fills if price trades 0.05% through it; real Binance funding for every 8h funding event the trade was open through.

**Money:** fixed **$5 risk per trade** (no compounding), on a notional **$1000 account per coin** — so equity below is $1000 + cumulative profit. Profit is booked in the month the trade *closes*. Max drawdown is peak-to-trough on closed-trade equity.

**Tuning status:** the Bollinger/SMA/stop/time-exit settings were picked on 2019–22 BTC, ETH and SOL and frozen; 2023→2026 was never used for tuning, and ZEC, NEAR, ADA, GALA were never used at all. The 4R target was picked after looking at all years (rr4.js), so it is mildly in-sample everywhere.

### Look-ahead / repainting checks (run in this script)

| Coin | Truncation cuts | Orders compared | Mismatches | App engine trades | Bot trades | Same entry and exit candle | Candles touching both stop and target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SOL | 100 | 30,682 | **0** | 308 | 308 | 308 | 0 (counted as stops) |
| ZEC | 100 | 35,260 | **0** | 332 | 332 | 332 | 0 (counted as stops) |
| NEAR | 100 | 30,140 | **0** | 297 | 297 | 297 | 1 (counted as stops) |
| ADA | 100 | 27,357 | **0** | 328 | 328 | 328 | 0 (counted as stops) |
| GALA | 100 | 23,556 | **0** | 243 | 243 | 243 | 0 (counted as stops) |

The truncation test runs the app's engine on candles up to a random cut only and checks every decision up to the cut matches the full-history run. Any use of future candles would make them differ. The bot is a second, independent implementation; it matches the app trade for trade.

### SOL — market regime by year (from the candles)

Buy-and-hold = first open to last close of the year. Volatility = annualised from 4h returns. Trend efficiency = |net move| ÷ total distance travelled by weekly closes (1 = straight line, near 0 = going nowhere). Above SMA200 = share of 4h closes above the 200-candle SMA. SMA crosses = how often price flipped sides of it (whipsaw).

### ADA — market regime by year (from the candles)

Buy-and-hold = first open to last close of the year. Volatility = annualised from 4h returns. Trend efficiency = |net move| ÷ total distance travelled by weekly closes (1 = straight line, near 0 = going nowhere). Above SMA200 = share of 4h closes above the 200-candle SMA. SMA crosses = how often price flipped sides of it (whipsaw).

### GALA — market regime by year (from the candles)

Buy-and-hold = first open to last close of the year. Volatility = annualised from 4h returns. Trend efficiency = |net move| ÷ total distance travelled by weekly closes (1 = straight line, near 0 = going nowhere). Above SMA200 = share of 4h closes above the 200-candle SMA. SMA crosses = how often price flipped sides of it (whipsaw).

## 5. Candidate improvements — tested, train vs held-out

Each idea is run inside the bot (a skipped signal frees the slot for the next one). Thresholds come from trades **before 2023 only**. "Before 2023" is partly the tuning period; **2023→ is the fair test**. All coins, $5 risk, same costs.

| Idea | Before 2023: trades, avg, net | 2023→: trades, avg, net | 2023→ max DD (all coins) | 2023→ per coin net (SOL / ZEC / NEAR / ADA / GALA) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline (as tested above) | 556, +0.40R, +$1111 | 952, +0.29R, **+$1367** | −$121 | +$310 / +$309 / +$210 / +$238 / +$301 |
| Skip if the last 10 days already trended hard (trend efficiency > 0.18, top third) | 394, +0.45R, +$895 | 689, +0.32R, **+$1116** | −$125 | +$212 / +$309 / +$116 / +$169 / +$309 |
| Skip if price crossed the SMA200 ≥ 3 times in the last 30 days (whipsaw) | 253, +0.34R, +$432 | 341, +0.06R, **+$101** | −$120 | +$15 / +$84 / −$17 / −$50 / +$70 |
| Only trade when ATR% is in the bottom third of its 90-day range (rank < 0.23) | 218, +0.58R, +$634 | 309, +0.43R, **+$662** | −$108 | +$141 / +$266 / +$35 / +$82 / +$138 |
| Break-even stop once +1R is reached | 609, +0.26R, +$801 | 1042, +0.21R, **+$1110** | −$123 | +$267 / +$199 / +$204 / +$170 / +$270 |
| Break-even stop once +2R is reached | 565, +0.33R, +$943 | 965, +0.25R, **+$1224** | −$118 | +$270 / +$272 / +$214 / +$191 / +$277 |
